name: Burst Puffer
fact: Puffers are slow swimmers, so puffing up is how they stay safe.

name: Ice Jelly
fact: Some jellyfish live happily in the freezing water under Arctic ice.

name: Spark Eel
fact: Electric eels can make enough electricity to light up a bulb.

name: Rainbow Starfish
fact: A starfish can grow back an arm if it loses one.

name: Treasure Crab
fact: Hermit crabs move into bigger shells as they grow.

name: Laser Shrimp
fact: Pistol shrimp snap a claw so fast that it makes a flash of light.
